_readme: Auction XI UI strings. {braces} are values the game fills in - keep them, and keep their names. Lists (sim.*, ticker.*) are interchangeable phrasings; a language may ship as many or as few as reads well. Player names, clubs, nationalities, ratings, prices and the Auction XI brand are data and never appear here.

common.dbLoadFailed: Failed to load the player database. Please make sure players.json and the pools folder sit next to index.html.

app.tagline: Build your eleven. Spend it wisely. Nobody gets a refund.

home.how1: Footballers come up one at a time. Everyone starts with the same budget.
home.how2: Bid against each other — when the timer runs out, the highest bid signs the player.
home.how3: Fill every position in your formation, then see who built the better team.
home.choose: Choose how you want to play
home.modeExplain:

tutorial.pickLanguageSub: You can change this any time from the home screen.
tutorial.step1Text: Real footballers come up for sale one at a time. Everyone in the room is a manager, and you all bid for the same player.
tutorial.step2Text: One budget, one squad to fill. Every million you spend on a superstar is a million you no longer have for the rest of your team.
tutorial.step3Text: Raise the price to stay in, or pass and keep your money. When the timer hits zero, the highest bid signs the player.
tutorial.step4Title: Nothing is final until it's sold
tutorial.step4Text: If nobody wants the player on offer, reroll and a different one comes up. And if you passed too early, just bid again — passing only lasts until you change your mind.
tutorial.step5Text: You are building a real formation, so every slot has to be filled. Win the striker, and you still need a goalkeeper.

live.step1: This round, the first player up for bid is {name} ({position}).
live.step2: Watch the timer - when it hits zero, the highest bid wins the player.
live.step3: Raise your offer with the − and + buttons, then tap {btn}.
live.step4: Done with him? Tap {btn} to pass and save your budget. Changed your mind? Bid again and you are straight back in.

tutorial.step6Text: Your squads play it out match by match: live commentary, possession and xG, then player ratings and a man of the match. That is where you find out who really drafted best.

blind.step1: Sealed bids this round. Nobody can see anyone else's offer — or even that one exists. Put in your best price; everything is revealed when the timer ends.

classic.tagline: The full match. A real eleven, drafted position by position.
bullets: Bids move in 5M steps, and every player is priced by rating
The best players come out first - quality drops phase by phase
Every slot is its own signing: LCB and RCB are different players
Played out as a 90-minute football match

sixv6.name: 6 v 6 Futsal
sixv6.tagline: Short, cheap and unpredictable. Six a side, futsal rules.
bullets: Bids move in 1M steps, and EVERY player opens at 1M - the room decides what they are worth
Completely random order: a 94-rated superstar can turn up in the last round
Slots are interchangeable - any forward fills either forward spot
Played out as a high-scoring futsal match, not a football one

draw.phaseDesc: Stars first, bargains last. Every pass offers a weaker slice of the pool.
draw.randomDesc: Any player in any round, though better players are a little more likely.

rule.packDesc: Unsold players return next lap at a lower price. Draw no bids twice and whoever needs players most takes them, so every squad fills.
